## A1 world, progression and save boundary

Only the adjacent Canopy–Basin route is in this leaf. Preserve existing opening/island/reef coordinates and geometry. Add the paid suit350 refit from existing <=150 m Canopy sources, four Basin patches (two loose alloy salvage, two crust-bearing survey fins), C05/C06 and physical approaches/retreat/rescue. Dart180 reaches the 160–175 m first stock; suit350 permits safe exit. Do not require Dart350 to reach that stock, or create Creel/carrier construction before M2-B.

Use `src/content/routes.ts` for readonly route/region/geometry/recovery descriptors, not a second mutable registry. Registry still owns stable place/source/recipe/evidence IDs and stock. Geometry authorities must be directly consumable by A2. Regional activation is rendering only; depletion, knowledge, pursuit and recovery remain in simulation. No saved active-render-region, speculative quest engine, or empty later-milestone state.

World bounds may expand only to support the adjoining Basin and its approach/rescue loop. Author and document exact horizontal AND vertical limits and safe transition geometry; do not unlock a content-free whole campaign. Preserve the old source-ledged terrain exactly inside the legacy rectangle, including old-source iteration order. New source definitions must not silently participate in the old global ledge loop. Any additional Canopy physical cover must preserve existing safe poses and have explicit shared bounds. Keep accepted rib sweep/separation and movement semantics. Root inspects all concrete coordinates, exports and geometry evidence before A2/A3 start.

`src/sim/capabilities.ts` will own read-only personal pressure capability. Existing `progression.personalLimit(state)` remains as a compatible delegate. Upgrade the one fitted suit transactionally from150 to350, preserving its instance identity, earlier recipe receipts and the actual paid cost; do not duplicate fitted suits or refund its investment. No hull rating/thermal/brine module expansion in A1.

**New writes: schema3 / content `expedition.4`.** Keep the atomic journal, lock, session and import protections. Validate schema1/foundation.1 and schema2/expedition.2 or expedition.3 against their old closed domains before conversion; then strictly validate schema3. Freeze historical definitions/validator dependencies instead of validating old payloads with expanded registries. This includes old world bounds, recipe/source/evidence domains, provenance, capacities, trim and carrier transactions. Preserve old stock/reserves, IDs, paid investment, modules, ticks, records, facilities, valid poses and fixture identity. Initialize only new content once. No decode teleport or relaxed arbitrary-ID acceptance.

For an active recovery operation, schema3 adds a stable route identity (`canopy` or `basin`) selected on initiation; legacy active operations map to `canopy` with their original waypoint semantics. Author explicit approach and tow/canister geometry; never reinterpret an old waypoint number as a new route. Preserve the route through reload, refusal and repair interruption. No route selection by current rendered region. Closed operation IDs and bounds are validated; all successful paused commands are immediately saveable. Broader deep recovery and mobile-refuge registration remain M2-B/C.

Recipe prices and source yields are executable tuning within the integration requirements, delegated to A1 with a ledger/proof. Reconcile the provisional economy with actual M1 costs and optional trim. Guarantee preceding-tier affordability, two sources per critical material, useful cargo, optional spending and recovery reserves without mining an inaccessible deposit. No claim of ordinary route margins from seeded arithmetic.

## OS3-01 producer contract — frozen for A1

Add exactly this transient union member to `GameEvent`:

```ts
{ type: "threat-damage"; source: "hunter";
  target: { kind: "vehicle"; vehicleId: string } | { kind: "diver" };
  loss: number; healthAfter: number }
```

Only the existing hunter bite branch emits it. Loss is actual positive raw health removed, limited to health that existed; `healthAfter` is nonnegative. Preserve the current hull clamp and diver mutation, damage formulas, AI behavior, periodic spatial sound and metrics. Snapshot target before survival can disable/incapacitate it; emit before those outcomes. No origin, position, speed, save field, collision attribution or health-delta inference. Zero applied loss emits nothing. Retain generic incapacity wording; it can have multiple simultaneous causes.

## OS3-01 presentation direction — A3 consumes inspected A1

Use unsaved active-time state in `EncounterPresentation`: same-target bites form an episode ending3 seconds after its last bite. Accumulate raw loss, round only display, onset flash plus at most one sustained flash per active second. Reuse the impact-chip area, keeping bite and collision accumulators separate and preserving collision-only behavior. Suppress calm hints during this aftermath without extending actual pursuit. Visible injury feedback works with mute and opening captions off.

Event identity is authoritative, not a guess from final health. A bitten hull that becomes disabled remains the target while still controlled. Same-step diver incapacity or subsequent recovery/actor change clears bite feedback and gives recovery its normal priority. App processes events against each step's state, observing actor transitions before accepting damage; final-frame state alone cannot retroactively relabel a hit. Clear damage on pause/panels/menu, actor replacement, refuge/recovery, new/import/Continue, graphics loss/reconstruction and disposal. Inspect the actual availability callback; do not assume context reconstruction calls `entered()`.

Use one separate accessible onset announcement per episode, with no per-tick live-region writes. Same-step disable/recovery alerts take priority over the bite onset; retain the chip for the disabled hull but do not issue competing assertive alerts in that batch. No stale deferred write after a reset. Preserve exit-refusal announcement ordering, action receipts, persistence errors, hazard banners and call origins. Native mutation traces prove delivery, not actual screen-reader speech. A3 must document exact arbitration before composition.

One centred onset damage sound is permitted only when that event batch contains no damage/recovery cue and feedback onset is still valid. Retain existing spatial cadence; no `sound.ts` change is needed for this finding. Multiple fixed steps within one frame accumulate once per step with a single onset.

Correct the advisory timing typo in tests:40 steps at60 Hz is2/3 second and totals8 hull points; it cannot contain flashes at1 and2 seconds. Use a separate >=121-step sustained case for pulse cadence. Required single-step, zero-loss, simultaneous collision, disable/incapacity, reset, actor-switch, batch, mute/captions and960/1280 layout checks remain.

Cargo and modules kept.` This deliberately names the actual containers rather than suggesting locker cells are serviced. Meal text: `Meal eaten · food ${Math.round(s.player.vitals.food)}`. Intake habitat text: `Tagged maintenance panels beside the intake.` Do not rewrite saved fixture feedback or registry provenance. A3 removes the dangling title separator. No new routine subtitles or repeated explanatory paragraphs.

Root retains interface/integration ownership. Leaf authors return exact exports and audits, never silently widen paths or dispatch children. A2 and A3 start from the same committed, inspected A1; composition proves the ordinary earned route/return/recovery/reload and bite feedback. Acceptance is for the complete batch, then integrated M2 and its Opus review; M3/M4 remain required.
